title: LaTeXBuildRecord
description: Structured record of one LaTeX build-repair cycle: environment, exact commands, pass convergence, diagnosed errors, applied fixes, package/font inventory, and reproducibility notes. Written by src/build.py (automated part) and completed by the agent (errors_fixed, template, reproducibility_notes).

schema_version.description: Version of this schema; build.py writes '1.0'.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp of report generation, ISO 8601.

case_id.description: Optional originating case identifier when the record is embedded in a case result.

jobname.description: Basename of the main file without extension.

main_file.description: Path of the main .tex file relative to the project directory.

engine.description: TeX engine used for the final passes.

distro.description: TeX distribution and release, e.g. 'TeX Live 2023/Debian' or 'MiKTeX 24.1'.

latexmk_version.description: latexmk --version output when latexmk was used.

bib_tool.description: Bibliography tool used (bibtex, biber) or null.

version.description: Version string from the .log 'Document Class:' line, if reported.

date.description: Class date from the .log, if reported.

source.description: Where the class file came from: 'system', 'project_dir', 'downloaded', or 'unknown'.

engine_required.description: Engine the template requires (pdflatex/xelatex/lualatex) when known; null when not specified.

converged.description: True when: no error lines, no 'Rerun to get ...' message, and no undefined/multiply-defined reference or citation remains after the aux files stabilised.

rerun_needed.description: True when the final log still requests another pass.

error_count.description: Number of distinct fatal error diagnostics in the final log.

warning_count.description: Number of distinct non-fatal warnings in the final log.

broken_reference_count.description: Number of remaining undefined/multiply-defined reference or citation warnings.

file.description: File where the error was reported; '<main>' when the engine gave no file.

line.description: 1-based line; 0 when the engine gave no line.

category.description: Taxonomy category driving the fix decision tree.

packages.description: Packages loaded during the final pass, with version and date from the .log.

fonts.description: Font files embedded or declared, from the .log.

name.description: Font filename or TeX font specifier.

commands.description: Every external command actually executed, in order, with exit code and duration.

passes.description: Summary of each compile pass (engine or bibliography tool).

errors_fixed.description: Agent-authored fix log: every applied repair with before/after evidence.

before.description: Snippet of the offending source before the fix.

after.description: Verification evidence: error gone / warning count reduced / pass count.

aux_snapshot.description: md5 of each auxiliary file at end of build; null when the file does not exist.

pdf_bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes, or null when no PDF was produced.

exact_commands.description: Exact ordered command lines a third party must run from the project directory.

clean_rebuild_advised.description: Whether to verify by deleting aux files and rebuilding.

reproducibility_notes.description: Human-written note: template/package/font versions, any substitution, and any step that cannot be automated.
